name: Locust The
overview: The locust, as depicted in Exodus 10, serves as a powerful instrument of God's judgment against Pharaoh and Egypt, covering the land so completely that the earth itself is obscured and all remaining vegetation is consumed. This plague demonstrates the overwhelming and destructive nature of locusts, which invade homes and devastate resources in a manner unseen by previous generations, underscoring God's sovereign power to punish the ungodly and deliver His people. The narrative emphasizes the locusts' role in compelling Pharaoh to release Israel, highlighting their function as agents of divine discipline and deliverance.
